import "strings"
import "array"

// Settings
_bucket = "efd/autogen"
_range  = -7d

// 1) Static lookup table: index → louver name
louverMap = array.from(
    rows: [
        {idx: 0,  name: "A1"},
        {idx: 1,  name: "A2"},
        {idx: 2,  name: "B1"},
        {idx: 3,  name: "B2"},
        {idx: 4,  name: "B3"},
        {idx: 5,  name: "C1"},
        {idx: 6,  name: "C2"},
        {idx: 7,  name: "C3"},
        {idx: 8,  name: "D1"},
        {idx: 9,  name: "D2"},
        {idx: 10, name: "D3"},
        {idx: 11, name: "E1"},
        {idx: 12, name: "E2"},
        {idx: 13, name: "E3"},
        {idx: 14, name: "F1"},
        {idx: 15, name: "F2"},
        {idx: 16, name: "F3"},
        {idx: 17, name: "G1"},
        {idx: 18, name: "G2"},
        {idx: 19, name: "G3"},
        {idx: 20, name: "H1"},
        {idx: 21, name: "H2"},
        {idx: 22, name: "H3"},
        {idx: 23, name: "I1"},
        {idx: 24, name: "I2"},
        {idx: 25, name: "I3"},
        {idx: 26, name: "L1"},
        {idx: 27, name: "L2"},
        {idx: 28, name: "L3"},
        {idx: 29, name: "M1"},
        {idx: 30, name: "M2"},
        {idx: 31, name: "M3"},
        {idx: 32, name: "N1"},
        {idx: 33, name: "N2"},
    ],
)

// 2a) Positions – last positionActualN per louver (plus timestamp)
positionsActual =
    from(bucket: _bucket)
        |> range(start: _range)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTDome.louvers" and
            r._field =~ /^positionActual[0-9]+$/
        )
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            idx: int(
                v: strings.replaceAll(
                    v: r._field,
                    t: "positionActual",
                    u: "",
                ),
            ),
            position: r._value,
            positionTime: r._time,
        }))
        |> keep(columns: ["idx", "position", "positionTime"])

// 2b) Commanded positions – last positionCommandedN per louver (plus timestamp)
positionsCommanded =
    from(bucket: _bucket)
        |> range(start: _range)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTDome.louvers" and
            r._field =~ /^positionCommanded[0-9]+$/
        )
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            idx: int(
                v: strings.replaceAll(
                    v: r._field,
                    t: "positionCommanded",
                    u: "",
                ),
            ),
            positionCommanded: r._value,
            positionCommandedTime: r._time,
        }))
        |> keep(columns: ["idx", "positionCommanded", "positionCommandedTime"])

// 2c) Join actual + commanded positions on idx
positions =
    join(
        tables: {act: positionsActual, cmd: positionsCommanded},
        on: ["idx"],
    )

// 3a) States – last stateN per louver (plus timestamp)
states =
    from(bucket: _bucket)
        |> range(start: _range)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTDome.logevent_louversMotion" and
            r._field =~ /^state[0-9]+$/
        )
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            idx: int(
                v: strings.replaceAll(
                    v: r._field,
                    t: "state",
                    u: "",
                ),
            ),
            stateRaw: int(v: r._value),
            stateTime: r._time,
        }))
        |> keep(columns: ["idx", "stateRaw", "stateTime"])

// 3b) inPosition – last inPositionN per louver (plus timestamp)
inPositions =
    from(bucket: _bucket)
        |> range(start: _range)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTDome.logevent_louversMotion" and
            r._field =~ /^inPosition[0-9]+$/
        )
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            idx: int(
                v: strings.replaceAll(
                    v: r._field,
                    t: "inPosition",
                    u: "",
                ),
            ),
            inPosition: r._value,       // bool from EFD
            inPositionTime: r._time,
        }))
        |> keep(columns: ["idx", "inPosition", "inPositionTime"])

// 3c) Join state + inPosition on idx
motion =
    join(
        tables: {st: states, ip: inPositions},
        on: ["idx"],
    )

// 4) Join positions + motion on idx
posStates =
    join(
        tables: {pos: positions, mo: motion},
        on: ["idx"],
    )

// 5a) Real row-3 louvers (…3: B3, C3, …, M3)
row3Real =
    join(tables: {ps: posStates, names: louverMap}, on: ["idx"])
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name =~ /3$/)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            _time: r.stateTime,
            idx: r.idx,
            name: r.name,
            position: r.position,
            positionCommanded: r.positionCommanded,
            inPosition: r.inPosition,
            position_time: r.positionTime,
            positionCommanded_time: r.positionCommandedTime,
            state_time: r.stateTime,
            stateName:
                if r.stateRaw == 1 then "ERROR"
                else if r.stateRaw == 2 then "CLOSED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 3 then "CLOSING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 4 then "CRAWLING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 5 then "MOVING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 6 then "OPEN"
                else if r.stateRaw == 7 then "OPENING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 8 then "PARKED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 9 then "PARKING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 10 then "STOPPED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 11 then "STOPPING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 12 then "STOPPING_BRAKING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 13 then "STOPPED_BRAKED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 14 then "BRAKE_DISENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 15 then "BRAKES_DISENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 16 then "BRAKE_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 17 then "BRAKES_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 18 then "DEFLATED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 19 then "DEFLATING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 20 then "DISABLING_MOTOR_POWER"
                else if r.stateRaw == 21 then "DISENGAGING_BRAKE"
                else if r.stateRaw == 22 then "DISENGAGING_BRAKES"
                else if r.stateRaw == 23 then "ENABLING_MOTOR_POWER"
                else if r.stateRaw == 24 then "ENGAGING_BRAKE"
                else if r.stateRaw == 25 then "ENGAGING_BRAKES"
                else if r.stateRaw == 26 then "FINAL_DOWN_CLOSE_LS_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 27 then "FINAL_DOWN_OPEN_LS_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 28 then "FINAL_UP_CLOSE_LS_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 29 then "FINAL_UP_OPEN_LS_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 30 then "GLYCOL_FLOWING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 31 then "GO_DEGRADED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 32 then "GO_NORMAL"
                else if r.stateRaw == 33 then "GO_STATIONARY"
                else if r.stateRaw == 34 then "INCLINED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 35 then "INFLATED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 36 then "INFLATING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 37 then "LP_DISENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 38 then "LP_DISENGAGING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 39 then "LP_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 40 then "LP_ENGAGING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 41 then "MOTOR_COOLING_OFF"
                else if r.stateRaw == 42 then "MOTOR_COOLING_ON"
                else if r.stateRaw == 43 then "MOTOR_POWER_OFF"
                else if r.stateRaw == 44 then "MOTOR_POWER_ON"
                else if r.stateRaw == 45 then "PROXIMITY_CLOSED_LS_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 46 then "PROXIMITY_OPEN_LS_ENGAGED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 47 then "STARTING_MOTOR_COOLING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 48 then "STOPPING_MOTOR_COOLING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 49 then "UNDETERMINED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 50 then "VERTICAL"
                else if r.stateRaw == 51 then "WAITING_AMCS_STATIONARY"
                else if r.stateRaw == 52 then "DISABLED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 53 then "DISABLING"
                else if r.stateRaw == 54 then "ENABLED"
                else if r.stateRaw == 55 then "ENABLING"
                else "UNKNOWN",
            isDummy: false,
        }))

// 5b) Dummy placeholders for A3 and N3 (no real telemetry)
// Note: keep inPosition as bool so union has consistent schema.
dummyRow3 =
    array.from(
        rows: [
            {
                _time: now(),
                idx: 0,
                name: " ",                                // blank label
                position: float(v: 0.0) / float(v: 0.0),   // NaN
                positionCommanded: float(v: 0.0) / float(v: 0.0),
                inPosition: false,
                stateName: " ",
                position_time: now(),
                positionCommanded_time: now(),
                state_time: now(),
                isDummy: true,
            },
            {
                _time: now(),
                idx: 34,
                name: " ",                                // blank label
                position: float(v: 0.0) / float(v: 0.0),
                positionCommanded: float(v: 0.0) / float(v: 0.0),
                inPosition: false,
                stateName: " ",
                position_time: now(),
                positionCommanded_time: now(),
                state_time: now(),
                isDummy: true,
            },
        ],
    )

// 5c) Union real + dummy, convert inPosition to display string, and keep columns
union(tables: [row3Real, dummyRow3])
    |> sort(columns: ["idx"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        idx: r.idx,
        name: r.name,
        position: r.position,
        positionCommanded: r.positionCommanded,
        // Display string: blank for dummy entries, "true"/"false" for real ones.
        inPosition: if r.isDummy then " " else if r.inPosition then "true" else "false",
        // Blank out stateName for dummy entries.
        stateName: if r.isDummy then " " else r.stateName,
        position_time: r.position_time,
        positionCommanded_time: r.positionCommanded_time,
        state_time: r.state_time,
    }))
    |> keep(columns: [
        "_time",
        "idx",
        "name",
        "position",
        "positionCommanded",
        "inPosition",
        "stateName",
        "position_time",
        "positionCommanded_time",
        "state_time",
    ])

        {idx: 6,  name: "C2"},
        {idx: 7,  name: "C3"},
        {idx: 8,  name: "D1"},
        {idx: 9,  name: "D2"},
        {idx: 10, name: "D3"},
        {idx: 11, name: "E1"},
        {idx: 12, name: "E2"},
        {idx: 13, name: "E3"},
        {idx: 14, name: "F1"},
        {idx: 15, name: "F2"},
        {idx: 16, name: "F3"},
        {idx: 17, name: "G1"},
        {idx: 18, name: "G2"},
        {idx: 19, name: "G3"},
        {idx: 20, name: "H1"},
        {idx: 21, name: "H2"},
        {idx: 22, name: "H3"},
        {idx: 23, name: "I1"},
        {idx: 24, name: "I2"},

        {idx: 26, name: "L1"},

        {idx: 29, name: "M1"},
        {idx: 30, name: "M2"},
        {idx: 31, name: "M3"},
        {idx: 32, name: "N1"},
        {idx: 33, name: "N2"},
    ],
)

// 2a) Positions – last positionActualN per louver (plus timestamp)
positionsActual =
    from(bucket: _bucket)
        |> range(start: _range)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTDome.louvers" and
            r._field =~ /^positionActual[0-9]+$/
        )
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            idx: int(
                v: strings.replaceAll(
                    v: r._field,
                    t: "positionActual",
                    u: "",
                ),
            ),
            position: r._value,
            positionTime: r._time,
        }))
        |> keep(columns: ["idx", "position", "positionTime"])

// 2b) Commanded positions – last positionCommandedN per louver (plus timestamp)
positionsCommanded =
    from(bucket: _bucket)
        |> range(start: _range)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTDome.louvers" and
            r._field =~ /^positionCommanded[0-9]+$/
        )
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            idx: int(
                v: strings.replaceAll(
                    v: r._field,
                    t: "positionCommanded",
                    u: "",
                ),
            ),
            positionCommanded: r._value,
            positionCommandedTime: r._time,
        }))
        |> keep(columns: ["idx", "positionCommanded", "positionCommandedTime"])

// 2c) Join actual + commanded positions on idx
positions =
    join(
        tables: {act: positionsActual, cmd: positionsCommanded},
        on: ["idx"],
    )

// 3a) States – last stateN per louver (plus timestamp)
states =
    from(bucket: _bucket)
        |> range(start: _range)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTDome.logevent_louversMotion" and
            r._field =~ /^state[0-9]+$/
        )
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            idx: int(
                v: strings.replaceAll(
                    v: r._field,
                    t: "state",
                    u: "",
                ),
            ),
            stateRaw: int(v: r._value),
            stateTime: r._time,
        }))
        |> keep(columns: ["idx", "stateRaw", "stateTime"])

// 3b) inPosition – last inPositionN per louver (plus timestamp)
inPositions =
    from(bucket: _bucket)
        |> range(start: _range)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTDome.logevent_louversMotion" and
            r._field =~ /^inPosition[0-9]+$/
        )
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            idx: int(
                v: strings.replaceAll(
                    v: r._field,
                    t: "inPosition",
                    u: "",
                ),
            ),
            inPosition: r._value,
            inPositionTime: r._time,
        }))
        |> keep(columns: ["idx", "inPosition", "inPositionTime"])

// 3c) Join state + inPosition on idx
motion =
    join(
        tables: {st: states, ip: inPositions},
        on: ["idx"],
    )

// 4) Join positions + motion on idx
posStates =
    join(
        tables: {pos: positions, mo: motion},
        on: ["idx"],
    )

// 5) Join with louver map, decode state, filter for row 1 (…1), and output
join(tables: {ps: posStates, names: louverMap}, on: ["idx"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name =~ /1$/)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r.stateTime,
        idx: r.idx,
        name: r.name,

        position: r.position,
        positionCommanded: r.positionCommanded,
        inPosition: r.inPosition,

        position_time: r.positionTime,
        positionCommanded_time: r.positionCommandedTime,
        state_time: r.stateTime,

        stateName:
            if r.stateRaw == 1 then "ERROR"
            else if r.stateRaw == 2 then "CLOSED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 3 then "CLOSING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 4 then "CRAWLING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 5 then "MOVING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 6 then "OPEN"
            else if r.stateRaw == 7 then "OPENING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 8 then "PARKED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 9 then "PARKING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 10 then "STOPPED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 11 then "STOPPING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 12 then "STOPPING_BRAKING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 13 then "STOPPED_BRAKED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 14 then "BRAKE_DISENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 15 then "BRAKES_DISENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 16 then "BRAKE_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 17 then "BRAKES_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 18 then "DEFLATED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 19 then "DEFLATING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 20 then "DISABLING_MOTOR_POWER"
            else if r.stateRaw == 21 then "DISENGAGING_BRAKE"
            else if r.stateRaw == 22 then "DISENGAGING_BRAKES"
            else if r.stateRaw == 23 then "ENABLING_MOTOR_POWER"
            else if r.stateRaw == 24 then "ENGAGING_BRAKE"
            else if r.stateRaw == 25 then "ENGAGING_BRAKES"
            else if r.stateRaw == 26 then "FINAL_DOWN_CLOSE_LS_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 27 then "FINAL_DOWN_OPEN_LS_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 28 then "FINAL_UP_CLOSE_LS_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 29 then "FINAL_UP_OPEN_LS_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 30 then "GLYCOL_FLOWING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 31 then "GO_DEGRADED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 32 then "GO_NORMAL"
            else if r.stateRaw == 33 then "GO_STATIONARY"
            else if r.stateRaw == 34 then "INCLINED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 35 then "INFLATED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 36 then "INFLATING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 37 then "LP_DISENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 38 then "LP_DISENGAGING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 39 then "LP_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 40 then "LP_ENGAGING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 41 then "MOTOR_COOLING_OFF"
            else if r.stateRaw == 42 then "MOTOR_COOLING_ON"
            else if r.stateRaw == 43 then "MOTOR_POWER_OFF"
            else if r.stateRaw == 44 then "MOTOR_POWER_ON"
            else if r.stateRaw == 45 then "PROXIMITY_CLOSED_LS_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 46 then "PROXIMITY_OPEN_LS_ENGAGED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 47 then "STARTING_MOTOR_COOLING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 48 then "STOPPING_MOTOR_COOLING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 49 then "UNDETERMINED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 50 then "VERTICAL"
            else if r.stateRaw == 51 then "WAITING_AMCS_STATIONARY"
            else if r.stateRaw == 52 then "DISABLED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 53 then "DISABLING"
            else if r.stateRaw == 54 then "ENABLED"
            else if r.stateRaw == 55 then "ENABLING"
            else "UNKNOWN",
    }))
    |> sort(columns: ["idx"])
    |> keep(columns: [
        "_time",
        "idx",
        "name",
        "position",
        "positionCommanded",
        "inPosition",
        "stateName",
        "position_time",
        "positionCommanded_time",
        "state_time",
    ])
